title: Boys plan to take the band and steal Harry's music
summary: Love explains the plan by some members to defect, and the music was stolen the night before a Madison contract.

And they were going to use one corner that the brother was playing in the West Trouble. So they stole the music, that's what gave the whole thing away. Harry had about $25 to $30 worth of new music. Which belonged to him personally. And when we went to bed in a little town, up around the highway there somewhere, the boys went to bed and stole the music. So we went to the lines, you see. We had a big job to play in, what's the capital of Wisconsin? Madison. Yeah, we had to play in Madison on a big job. Had to sign a contract, made a contract and everything. So these boys stole the music that night. When we went over there to play this big job with the big band, they wasn't going no further with Harry and they ain't going to take that job, you see. Well, we had to come back. And me and Harry, they had to come back and get shipped. Three of us would have to come back to the other guy. They didn't want Harry, they didn't want me, and they didn't want Ship. They didn't want to use no bass. So I told him, I said, don't you fool with them fellas.
I said, I'm kind of on that sand to keep that now. I said, the best thing you can do.
